entries.title: Discover the next eligible work
entries.instruction: Review the current project snapshot and claim the selected eligible work through the bounded CLI action.

entries.title: Claim the ready work item
entries.instruction: Claim the selected work item with the supplied revision and typed session identity.

entries.title: Inspect the open prerequisite
entries.instruction: Inspect the named prerequisite; this work remains queued until its default close-only satisfaction condition is met.

entries.title: Resolve the hard work block
entries.instruction: Ask the authorized operator to resolve the named hard block; do not claim or bypass it.

entries.title: Review the expired attempt
entries.instruction: Inspect the fenced expired attempt and worktree before an authorized disposition; do not blindly reclaim the work.

entries.title: Resume the current fenced attempt
entries.instruction: Reload the durable attempt and continue through its current safe action; do not claim replacement work.

entries.title: Obtain operator authorization
entries.instruction: An authorized operator must claim or explicitly resume this operator-only work item.

entries.title: Resume the paused work item
entries.instruction: An authorized operator must remove the explicit policy hold before this work can be claimed.

entries.title: Attach passed verification evidence
entries.instruction: Run the declared bounded validation gate and attach its structured receipt for the current subject and source snapshot.

entries.title: Finalize the verified work
entries.instruction: Submit the durable close intent with the current attempt fence and accepted proof; the final transaction will release ownership and close the work.

entries.title: Remain idle
entries.instruction: No safe action is available in this project snapshot; wait for a revision or operator intervention.
